g.text: Sequence UC-004 Gestion Admin + cascada — FR-011/012/013 / BR-004
material.isOwnedBy(callerId) [ajeno y no Admin -> 403, nada eliminado]
deleteMaterial(adminId, id) [rol Admin salta ownership, FR-012]
validateTarget (existe -> 404 si no; 403 si no Admin)
deleteCascade(userId) [transaccion: cuenta + N materials + N blobs]
DELETE users CASCADE materials CASCADE file_blobs (C-2)
Sin PATCH owner/transfer v1 (FR-014 eliminada). 401 antes que 404 sin JWT (BR-002).
